name: Mang le
summary: Báo Kon Tum lists măng le among dried foods at the weekend market, with trâu khô, bò khô, and thịt heo hun khói. The Vietnam Tourism rural portal lists măng rừng separately and does not say it is măng le. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Mang Den weekend market, on the Báo Kon Tum dried-food list.
howToEat: Báo Kon Tum names măng le as a dried food and does not print a recipe.
A price is Check on arrival. The opening hour is Check on arrival.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen meets on Saturday and Sunday. The Vietnam Tourism rural portal puts the pine-hill grounds on Hùng Vương in xã Măng Đen, Quảng Ngãi. Báo Kon Tum, on that portal, puts the same pine hill on Hùng Vương in thị trấn Măng Đen, Kon Plông, and another of its articles puts the market at Vườn thông by the district central square. The opening hour is Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Măng le is a dried food at the Mang Den weekend market on Báo Kon Tum. Măng rừng is a separate name. A price is Check on arrival.
